Page 81 Cont.
July 13 Marg. Anne Dumas - 3 - believed to have been injured at birth - can not see or talk and very little able to walk .... Enrolled as a perpetual member
13 Carol Sales - see April 8th
Mrs. Celia Laderwoot - 75 - prominent goitre -
Baby Gary Mich Fay - 6 weeks - born with paralysed arm - Mother non Cath. ( Methodist )
16 Thanks - Maurice Gauthier - 8 - of Belle River Ontario. Kicked by a horse Tuesday last week July 11 - seemed unconscious with fractured skull till Saturday when aunt phoned requesting enroll- ment and prayers. Next morning surprised every one asking for weniers - perfectly rational; is coming.fine. Deo Gr.
Rev. Paul Obenrader - missionary among colored ... in Erie, Pa. asks for prayers for his work ....
Page 82 July 19 19
John C. Childers - 54 - baptist - never baptized - sort of gout but he does not indulge as is unually the case of the sick.
V. Sister M. Agath - 43 yrs teaching - arthritis ..... of Oklahoma. John Scully - 45 - vericose - veins.
Mrs. Blogma Franklin - 43 - non Cath. doubts if ever baptized. Has arthritis since 1935 - husband instantly killed Oct. 1941. Since that time very much worse; inscribed in Ser. Masses
Kathleen Ryan - 15 - has been having Epi. fits for 4 yrs. - fell out of swing. Was cured for iz yrs. Lately started again. En- rolled again as a perpetual member.
Ww. Jobbitt - 14 - birth injury of Wayne, Mich. is not normal. Baby Gary Kornack - 3 mo. - water on brain - nothing stays on stomach.
Helen Granzow - 80 - physically fairly well; but out of Church and seemingly sadly without faith.
